answer: Grading rights need a surety: an established peer co-signs a bond, slashed if the identity grades badly or colludes. Liability is joint, so the guarantor backs only agents it has watched act independently and keeps watching, since one bad verdict drains its stake. A sybil farm can only vouch for itself in a closed ring, where one caught clone cascades liquidation through the ring; buying outside help fails, for a stranger prices in that risk. Jade-smooth credentials cannot borrow a pulse of trust. Cost: N liable guarantors, not self-signed shells, each a shale-thin link that snaps if fake.
